invariants.rule: Every persistent reference entity retains an immutable opaque SOMA relational identity independent of descriptive/business identifiers.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Rename/change matching attributes without changing relational identity or dependent relationships.

invariants.rule: Exactly one Local User Profile authenticates an installation; Contacts never become additional login profiles.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Attempt to create a second authenticating profile or use a Contact as authentication identity and require rejection.

invariants.rule: Contact identity cannot be established, merged, or selected solely by equal name, email, or other descriptive similarity.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Duplicate-name/email-scope fixtures preserve independent contacts and ambiguous candidate state.

invariants.rule: A Contact has zero or one current Customer Organization affiliation while prior affiliations remain historical evidence under the same Contact identity.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Affiliation reassignment closes prior current relation and preserves operation-specific historical context.

invariants.rule: Reference matching is deterministic, exact and scope-aware; fuzzy similarity never creates identity authority and multiple qualified candidates remain ambiguous.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Golden normalization vectors plus multi-candidate cases produce stable unresolved/unique/ambiguous outcomes.

invariants.rule: Dispatch Location is Customer-Organization-neutral and operation-neutral; logistics role or optional Site context cannot redefine its identity.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Reuse a standalone/linked location across valid operation roles without introducing customer ownership.

invariants.rule: Each Site has exactly one dedicated Dispatch Location, while a Dispatch Location links to at most one Site and may exist without one.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Site creation atomically creates/links one location; second-site link and Site-without-location persistence are rejected.

invariants.rule: Current mutable Dispatch Location/Site address data never rewrites immutable logistics snapshots already owned by operational history.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Change current master address and verify prior request/pickup snapshots remain unchanged.

invariants.rule: Archived reference records remain queryable as history but are ineligible for new active relationships until explicit reactivation.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Archived Contact/Dispatch Location is absent from new-active selectors but resolvable in historical views.

invariants.rule: Archival cannot strand an active unfinished dependency; blockers are returned without partial lifecycle mutation.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Active requester/Site/logistics/dependent-record scenarios block archive atomically.

invariants.rule: Reactivation is explicit, revalidated against current constraints, and audited without erasing the archived interval/history.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Reactivate valid and newly-conflicting references and verify revalidation/history behavior.

invariants.rule: A matching/reconciliation query never mutates a reference record; create, merge/link, reassignment, archive and correction are separate commands.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Run matching/preview repeatedly and verify zero authoritative mutations until an explicit command is accepted.

invariants.rule: Settings are typed and semantically owned by one module; the shared Settings workspace/registry does not become independent domain authority.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Domain setting validation remains identical whether changed from Settings UI or another governed command surface.

invariants.rule: Reading an absent setting/reference default never persists it implicitly.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Read-only settings/reference queries leave storage unchanged.
